H={(l,j):head(l,j) for l in range(4) for j in range(6)}
# output subspace Z of positional-copy heads 0,3,4
outs=[]
for j,r in ((4,3),(0,2),(3,1)):
    Q,K,V,O=H[(0,j)]; U,S,Vt=svd(O@V); outs.append(U[:,:r]*S[:r])
